dct_creator_sm: Morrow, Shawna (Department of Clinical Studies. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: The purpose of this dataset is to disclose all data collected from 50 veterinary clinical practice websites in Ontario. This includes clinical practice and staff demographics, as well as pet weight management information, products, and services advertised or displayed. Also included is the recoded version of the data used for statistical analysis, as well as a coding key and definitions to help describe certain variables. Supplementary data including the survey questions used during data collection and all pseudo R2 values collected are also included.
dct_title_s: Website investigation of pet weight management related information and services offered by Ontario veterinary practices
